Mail.DefaultHtmlBody:
Please find electronic version of Fire Wise attached.

Update records
With elections having taken place at many groups and brigades, Fire Wise is wanting to hear from you with any changes to your Captain or Secretary,
Group Officer or Group Secretary positions. This will help to keep our database up-to-date when distributing the publication over the next 12 months.
The details required of a person newly elected to any of these position would be full name, address and email,
as well as the title of office they have been elected to.

Thank you

Gordon Rippon-King
Managing Editor
